method: Primary agent inspected all 24 original Minecraft 1280x720 native framebuffer PNGs with view_image in four batches of six.
scope: Visual sample of all four sections; full platform/exhibit inventory is verified separately from saved NBT and model envelopes.
observations: Blue V12, green new, yellow absent, red error platforms visible; grass gaps and aligned grid preserved.
Russian signs, ID and category readable from the camera side after copying sign front text to back text.
Sampled native blocks, original RP entity models, new and map-absent art render with textures and transparency.
Large RP elevator, ladder and cage assemblies visible as whole objects above their separate assigned podiums; original transforms retained.
Error section: valid trapdoor model visible; source-defect diagnostic shown explicitly as red transparent glass and sign without fabricated mod ID.
Vanilla grass, concrete, stone and oak signs retain normal appearance without source resource pack.
No sampled missing-texture magenta checkerboard, overlapping exhibit platforms or model clipping by the gallery floor found.
limitations: 24 rendered samples, not a screenshot of each of 1885 exhibits.
Raised and hanging art retains source geometry and existing placement transforms.
Physical mouse and keyboard interaction cycle for every object NOT_RUN.
